items.title: fix(gateway): dedupe legacy Claude CLI gap-only turns (#199121)
items.summary: fix(gateway): dedupe legacy Claude CLI gap-only turns (#199121) fix(gateway): dedupe legacy Claude CLI gap-only turns OpenClaw v2026.11.1-v2026.11.3 could write a Claude CLI user turn that starts with the gap note alone, without the replay block: fresh sessions got the gap note while the replay block needed an existing native session. #199016 made history comparison recognize the replay-plus-gap shape only, so a gap-only turn still showed twice in chat.history. The replay block is now optional in that exact legacy pattern, which still matches only the shipped gap-note wordings. Comparison is read-time only: stored transcripts are not rewritten, nothing model-facing changes, and there is no new text or migration. Evidence: vitest-source, the new gap-only case fails on main and passes here, and the existing replay-plus-gap and drift cases keep their original wording. Source tier with an isolated HOME, a native Claude JSONL in the shipped gap-only shape bound to a claude-cli session, and chat.history over a loopback Gateway: main returned two user rows, this change returns one. Replay-plus-gap, drift-note-only and malformed-header controls behave the same on both, and the stored JSONL is byte-identical. Full build and packed smoke pass. Net 0 test lines. Follow-up to #199016 (#198606). Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
